statement: SpaceX spent approximately $18.4 billion of capex in Q2 2026, of which roughly $15.8 billion supported AI compute infrastructure.
why: It sizes in dollars how much one non-hyperscaler buyer is putting into AI infrastructure in a single quarter, most of which flows to accelerators and the racks around them.

impact.mechanism: Quarterly AI capex of this size converts directly into accelerator, network, and electrical equipment orders.

evidence.excerpt: Total company capital expenditures in the second quarter were approximately $18.4 billion, of which roughly $15.8 billion supported AI compute infrastructure.

confidence.basis: CFO-stated figure in a secondary transcript, not a filed financial statement.
